Name: Displays
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Displays[/b] adds mannequins you can use to display your clothes.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Purchase mannequins from Robin. Right-click with the item you want to put on it, or with an empty hand to swap what you currently have equipped. See [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/Displays#faqs]FAQs and known issues[/url].

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
